globals.name: Async
globals.documentation: Runs asynchronous functions and drives the task scheduler.

members.name: run
members.documentation: Runs pending work once and returns whether any tasks are still outstanding.

members.name: runToCompletion
members.documentation: Blocks until every started task has finished.

members.name: start
members.documentation: Begins running an asynchronous function and returns a task for its completion.

globals.name: Char
globals.documentation: Inspects and converts individual characters of a string.

members.name: convertFromUtf32
members.documentation: Returns the string for a Unicode code point, which may be a surrogate pair.

members.name: convertToUtf32
members.documentation: Returns the Unicode code point at the given index, combining surrogate pairs.

members.name: fromNumber
members.documentation: Returns the single character string for the given character code.

members.name: getNumericValue
members.documentation: Returns the numeric value the character represents, or -1 when it has none.

members.name: getUnicodeCategory
members.documentation: Returns the name of the Unicode category the character belongs to.

members.name: isControl
members.documentation: Returns true when the character is a control character.

members.name: isDigit
members.documentation: Returns true when the character is a decimal digit.

members.name: isHighSurrogate
members.documentation: Returns true when the character is the first half of a surrogate pair.

members.name: isLetter
members.documentation: Returns true when the character is a letter.

members.name: isLetterOrDigit
members.documentation: Returns true when the character is a letter or a decimal digit.

members.name: isLowSurrogate
members.documentation: Returns true when the character is the second half of a surrogate pair.

members.name: isLower
members.documentation: Returns true when the character is a lower case letter.

members.name: isNumber
members.documentation: Returns true when the character is any kind of number, including fractions and subscripts.

members.name: isPunctuation
members.documentation: Returns true when the character is punctuation.

members.name: isSeparator
members.documentation: Returns true when the character is a space, line, or paragraph separator.

members.name: isSurrogate
members.documentation: Returns true when the character is either half of a surrogate pair.

members.name: isSurrogatePair
members.documentation: Returns true when the character and the one after it form a surrogate pair.

members.name: isSymbol
members.documentation: Returns true when the character is a symbol, such as a currency or math sign.

members.name: isUpper
members.documentation: Returns true when the character is an upper case letter.

members.name: isWhiteSpace
members.documentation: Returns true when the character is whitespace.

members.name: toNumber
members.documentation: Returns the character code of the character at the given index.

globals.name: readLn
globals.documentation: Reads a line of text from the console, or null at the end of the input.

globals.name: print
globals.documentation: Writes each argument to the console as a string.

globals.name: printLn
globals.documentation: Writes each argument to the console as a string, followed by a line break.

globals.name: error
globals.documentation: Throws a runtime error with the given message.

globals.name: try
globals.documentation: Calls the function and returns an object holding either its result or the error it threw.

globals.name: Json
globals.documentation: Converts values to and from JSON text.

members.name: deserialize
members.documentation: Reads JSON text and returns the value it describes.

members.name: serialize
members.documentation: Converts the value to JSON text.

globals.name: Math
globals.documentation: Common mathematical functions, along with the constants PI and E.

members.name: abs
members.documentation: Returns the value without its sign.

members.name: acos
members.documentation: Returns the angle in radians whose cosine is the given value.

members.name: asin
members.documentation: Returns the angle in radians whose sine is the given value.

members.name: atan
members.documentation: Returns the angle in radians whose tangent is the given value.

members.name: atan2
members.documentation: Returns the angle in radians to the point (x, y), using both signs to pick the quadrant.

members.name: ceiling
members.documentation: Rounds the value up to the nearest whole number.

members.name: clamp
signatures: clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number
members.documentation: Returns the value limited to the range between min and max.

members.name: cos
members.documentation: Returns the cosine of an angle given in radians.

members.name: cosh
members.documentation: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of the value.

members.name: exp
members.documentation: Returns E raised to the given power.

members.name: floor
members.documentation: Rounds the value down to the nearest whole number.

members.name: log
members.documentation: Returns the logarithm of the value, in base E unless another base is given.

members.name: log10
members.documentation: Returns the base 10 logarithm of the value.

members.name: max
members.documentation: Returns the larger of the two values.

members.name: min
members.documentation: Returns the smaller of the two values.

members.name: pow
members.documentation: Returns x raised to the power of y.

members.name: round
members.documentation: Rounds the value to the nearest whole number.

members.name: sign
members.documentation: Returns -1, 0, or 1 depending on the sign of the value.

members.name: sin
members.documentation: Returns the sine of an angle given in radians.

members.name: sinh
members.documentation: Returns the hyperbolic sine of the value.

members.name: sqrt
members.documentation: Returns the square root of the value.

members.name: tan
members.documentation: Returns the tangent of an angle given in radians.

members.name: tanh
members.documentation: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of the value.

members.name: truncate
members.documentation: Discards the fractional part of the value.

globals.name: parseFloat
globals.documentation: Parses the string as a decimal number, returning undefined when it is not one.

globals.name: parseHex
globals.documentation: Parses the string as a hexadecimal number, returning undefined when it is not one.

globals.name: parseInt
globals.documentation: Parses the string as a whole number, returning undefined when it is not one.

globals.name: proxyCreate
globals.documentation: Wraps the target in an object that routes member access through the handler.

globals.name: require
globals.documentation: Loads another script and returns its exports, reusing the result on later calls.

globals.name: Task
globals.documentation: Creates and combines tasks for use with await.

members.name: delay
members.documentation: Returns a task that completes after the given number of seconds.

members.name: whenAll
members.documentation: Returns a task that completes once every given task has, with all of their results.

members.name: whenAny
members.documentation: Returns a task that completes as soon as any given task does, with that task.

globals.name: CancellationToken
globals.documentation: Signals to running tasks that they should stop.

members.name: isCancellationRequested
members.documentation: Returns true once cancellation has been requested.

members.name: register
members.documentation: Calls the given function when cancellation is requested.

members.name: throwIfCancellationRequested
members.documentation: Throws an error when cancellation has been requested, otherwise does nothing.

globals.name: CancellationTokenSource
globals.documentation: Hands out cancellation tokens and decides when they are cancelled.

members.name: cancel
members.documentation: Requests cancellation immediately.

members.name: cancelAfter
members.documentation: Requests cancellation after the given number of seconds.

members.name: getToken
members.documentation: Returns the token that this source cancels.

members.name: isCancellationRequested
members.documentation: Returns true once cancellation has been requested.

globals.name: Random
globals.documentation: Generates pseudo random numbers, optionally from a fixed seed.

members.name: next
members.documentation: Returns a whole number, below maxValue and at or above minValue when those are given.

members.name: nextDouble
members.documentation: Returns a number from 0 up to but not including 1.

globals.name: TaskCompletionSource
globals.documentation: Produces a task whose result is supplied by hand, for bridging callback based code.

members.name: getTask
members.documentation: Returns the task controlled by this source.

members.name: setCanceled
members.documentation: Completes the task as cancelled.

members.name: setException
members.documentation: Completes the task with an error carrying the given message.

members.name: setResult
members.documentation: Completes the task with the given result.

prototypes.name: Array
prototypes.documentation: Contains members available on every array.

members.name: add
members.documentation: Appends an item to the end of the array.

members.name: clear
members.documentation: Removes every item from the array.

members.name: contains
members.documentation: Returns true when the array holds an item equal to the given one.

members.name: getEnumerator
members.documentation: Returns an enumerator that walks the array, as used by foreach.

members.name: indexOf
members.documentation: Returns the index of the first matching item, or -1 when there is none.

members.name: insert
members.documentation: Inserts an item at the given index, shifting the following items along.

members.name: lastIndexOf
members.documentation: Returns the index of the last matching item, or -1 when there is none.

members.name: length
members.documentation: Returns the number of items in the array.

members.name: remove
members.documentation: Removes the first matching item and returns whether one was found.

members.name: removeAt
members.documentation: Removes the item at the given index.

members.name: sort
members.documentation: Sorts the array, or a range of it, in ascending order.

members.name: sortDescending
members.documentation: Sorts the array, or a range of it, in descending order.

prototypes.name: Function
prototypes.documentation: Contains members available on every function.

members.name: getName
members.documentation: Returns the declared name of the function, or undefined when it has none.

prototypes.name: Number
prototypes.documentation: Contains members available on every number.

members.name: isNaN
members.documentation: Returns true when the number is the result of an undefined operation, such as 0 / 0.

prototypes.name: Object
prototypes.documentation: Contains members available on every object.

members.name: add
members.documentation: Stores a value under the given key, replacing any existing entry.

members.name: clear
members.documentation: Removes every entry from the object.

members.name: containsKey
members.documentation: Returns true when the object has an entry under the given key.

members.name: containsValue
members.documentation: Returns true when any entry holds a value equal to the given one.

members.name: get
members.documentation: Returns the value stored under the given key, or undefined when there is none.

members.name: getEnumerator
members.documentation: Returns an enumerator that yields each entry as a key and value pair.

members.name: length
members.documentation: Returns the number of entries in the object.

members.name: lock
members.documentation: Makes the object read only and returns it.

members.name: remove
members.documentation: Removes the entry under the given key and returns whether one was found.

members.name: setPrototype
members.documentation: Sets the object this one inherits its members from and returns the object.

members.name: setPrototypeAndLock
members.documentation: Sets the prototype, makes the object read only, and returns it.

prototypes.name: String
prototypes.documentation: Contains members available on every string.

members.name: charAt
members.documentation: Returns the character at the given index as a string.

members.name: charCodeAt
members.documentation: Returns the character code of the character at the given index.

members.name: contains
members.documentation: Returns true when the string contains the given substring.

members.name: endsWith
members.documentation: Returns true when the string ends with the given substring.

members.name: format
members.documentation: Treats the string as a template and fills its numbered placeholders with the arguments.

members.name: getEnumerator
members.documentation: Returns an enumerator that yields each character of the string.

members.name: indexOf
members.documentation: Returns the index of the first occurrence of the substring, or -1 when there is none.

members.name: insert
members.documentation: Returns a new string with the given value inserted at the given index.

members.name: lastIndexOf
members.documentation: Returns the index of the last occurrence of the substring, or -1 when there is none.

members.name: length
members.documentation: Returns the number of characters in the string.

members.name: normalize
members.documentation: Returns the string in Unicode normalization form C, so equivalent text compares equal.

members.name: replace
members.documentation: Returns a new string with every occurrence of one substring swapped for another.

members.name: split
members.documentation: Splits the string on the given separator and returns the parts as an array.

members.name: startsWith
members.documentation: Returns true when the string starts with the given substring.

members.name: substring
members.documentation: Returns the part of the string starting at the given index, optionally limited to a length.

members.name: toLower
members.documentation: Returns the string converted to lower case.

members.name: toUpper
members.documentation: Returns the string converted to upper case.

members.name: trim
members.documentation: Returns the string with leading and trailing whitespace removed.

prototypes.name: Value
prototypes.documentation: Contains members common to ALL values.

members.name: getPrototype
members.documentation: Returns the object this value inherits its members from.

members.name: getType
members.documentation: Returns the name of the value's type, such as "number" or "object".

members.name: serialize
members.documentation: Returns the value written as Mond source, so it can be read back later.

members.name: toString
members.documentation: Returns a human readable string for the value.
